title: Canonical unit square from a monoidal clopen factorization
statement: Let j:Y→X be an open immersion of schemes, R a commutative-ring sheaf on the small pro-etale site of X, h a braided structure on module restriction, c a braided structure on degreewise cochain restriction, and d a braided structure on the specified exact derived restriction. Use the fixed native derived localization structures and canonical factors isomorphism of [def-pur-clopen-monoidal-normalization]. Suppose the inverse unit of c is the single-complex restriction comparison followed by the single-complex image of the ordinary inverse unit supplied by h. If factors.hom is monoidal for c, d and the native lax braided localization structures, then the inverse unit braidedUnit of d equals the canonical unitComparison. There is no tensor comparison b, K-flatness, flat-term, or boundedness assumption in this unit statement.

source.place: Tags 06YU and 0FPT, sites-cohomology-definition-derived-tor and sites-cohomology-lemma-symmetric-monoidal-derived; unit cancellation in step 2 of lem-pur-clopen-braided-model-squares.

proof.text: Use the generic monoidal natural transformation unit equation. Cancel the strong derived restriction unit map, then the target localization unit, which is invertible by RingedDerivedNative.isIso_ε. This yields inverse_unit_square_aux, an equality of inverse unit maps.

Substitute the given expression for the cochain inverse unit. Apply Iso.ext to the desired equality. Expand braidedUnit and the five factors of unitComparison. Functoriality splits the image of the two cochain maps, and associativity identifies the resulting map with the generic cancellation equation. This proves the result for every open immersion, including empty schemes and zero rings.

theorem clopen_braided_unit_square
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)})
    (h : (clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided)
    (c : (clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided)
    (hcη : c.toMonoidal.toOplaxMonoidal.η =
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
        (clopenTensorRestriction.{t, u} j R) (.up ℤ) (0 : ℤ)).app
          (𝟙_ (clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R))).hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) (0 : ℤ)).map
          (clopenTensorUnitComparison.{t, u} j R h).hom)
    (d : (derivedRestriction.{t, u} j R).Braided) :
    letI := c
    letI := d
    letI := RingedDerivedNative.laxBraided.{t + 1, t, u, max (u + 1) (t + 2)}
      (topology X) R
    letI := RingedDerivedNative.laxBraided.{t + 1, t, u, max (u + 1) (t + 2)}
      (topology Y) ((clopenTensorRings.{t, u} j).obj R)
    NatTrans.IsMonoidal (factors.{t, u} j R).hom →
      braidedUnit.{t, u} j R d = unitComparison.{t, u} j R h
